preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 1000.
The number of letters in the English alphabet up to which characters in s are allowed is between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: s is a string of length n consisting of small English letters
preconditions.description: The string s consists of small English letters and has a length of n.

preconditions.expression: s is tolerable according to the given definition
preconditions.description: The string s does not contain any palindrome contiguous substring of length 2 or more and each character is one of the first p letters of the English alphabet.

postconditions.expression: output is either a string of length n consisting of small English letters or the string 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is a string of the same length as the input string s, consisting of small English letters, or the string 'NO' if no larger tolerable string exists.
